rationale: Mohit brings deep ML infrastructure expertise and experience advising early-stage founders on technical scaling—exactly what an AI-SaaS team building automation tools needs as they grow. Yuzhen is building DaBoss.ai to make AI accessible for business operations, and Mohit's background as a founder plus his conviction that early-stage teams need better tooling and mentorship aligns well with helping them navigate the technical and operational challenges ahead.
intro_message: Mohit Jain, meet YUZHEN ZHU — you're both building in AI/automation space, and Mohit's experience scaling ML teams and advising on infrastructure could be valuable as DaBoss.ai grows.
